name: io.github.deciduus/calendar-mcp
description: Google Calendar for LLM agents: find, create, update, move, delete events; free/busy; scheduling.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID for a Google Cloud project with the Google Calendar API enabled.

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_FILE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional legacy single-token path. Leave unset to store accounts in the config directory.

environmentVariables.name: CALENDAR_MCP_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding per-account tokens and preferences.json. Defaults to the OS user config directory.

environmentVariables.name: CALENDAR_MCP_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Account name used when a tool's 'account' argument is omitted.
